title: Chapter 29 The Danger Of The Universe
content:
Chapter 29 The Danger Of The Universe

Sure enough, not long after, an ancient aura gushed out from the City Lord's Mansion.

The next moment, Gu Chen's figure appeared in front of everyone.

"Congratulations, breaking through the ancient realm."

Seeing Gu Chen, Lu Daosheng smiled slowly.

"Old brother, congratulations."

"Congratulations."

"Master, congratulations."

Suddenly, everyone followed suit to congratulate.

Hearing everyone's congratulations, Gu Chen couldn't stop smiling.

"This is all thanks to the City Lord. If it weren't for the City Lord, I wouldn't be where I am today."

As time passed, his gratitude to Lu Daosheng became deeper and deeper.

He often felt fortunate that he met Lu Daosheng.

There is no doubt that it was Lu Daosheng who changed his fate.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "Opportunities are seized by oneself."

In this way, the deserted city perfectly resolved this crisis.

Of course, this was when Lu Daosheng and some strong men did not take action.

And this also made Lu Daosheng more cautious.

The power of the deserted city is still a little insufficient.

A truly supreme force cannot be just superficial strength.

Behind the scenes, there must also be a terrifying force that can shock the enemy.

After a while, everyone left.

To prepare for the next defense.

According to Lu Daosheng, they are likely to fight back. After all, they can't just sit there and wait for death.

.........

In a huge abyss in the universe.

There is no life here, as if it is the end of the universe.

At this time, a faint corrosive black gas gradually overflowed from the abyss, accompanied by a strange and heart-pounding sound.

Suddenly, a figure appeared above the abyss.

Seeing the abyss like this, his face changed drastically.

"Retreat!"

With a charged blow, the man pressed his palm into the abyss.

In an instant, the entire abyss began to shake.

However, the black gas still did not dissipate, but became thicker and thicker.

Seeing this scene, the man's face was extremely ugly.

"Damn it, how, how could this happen?"

At this moment, a shrill voice suddenly came from the abyss.

"Hehehe, you can't stop our people."

Hearing this, the man stared at the abyss below with a solemn expression. The next moment, the man's face suddenly lost a trace of blood.

At the bottom of the abyss, a hideous crack was expanding.

And the endless black air was pouring out from it.

Buzz——

At this time, a strange purple pupil suddenly appeared in the crack, staring at the man above the abyss.

When you stare at the abyss, the abyss is also staring at you.

Without hesitation, the man turned around and ran.

Things were obviously beyond his control.

And near the abyss, in the direction where the man left, there was a huge defense line that almost spanned the entire universe.

As if defending something.

"Are they really coming?"

An old sigh slowly sounded from within the defense line.

As this voice sounded, countless powerful men with terrifying auras rushed out from within the defense line.

Darkness descended, and the universe was united to survive this disaster together.

If we win, the universe will be worry-free.

If we lose, the universe will perish.

.........

Somewhere in the Tianxuan world.

In a deep alley.

"Run, why don't you run, damn, you little brat, I'll beat you to death today."

A sturdy man looked down at a skinny little beggar in the corner, his eyes full of ferocity.

Then, the big man directly punched and kicked him.

Under the absolute crushing of strength, the little beggar had no power to fight back.

After an unknown amount of time, the big man seemed to be tired of fighting, spit, and then left cursing.

At the original place, the little beggar struggled to get up from the ground, and then leaned against the wall again.

Blood kept flowing out of his mouth, and his consciousness began to gradually blur.

He knew that he was going to die.

But he really didn't want to die.

Why, why did the world treat him like this.

The little beggar looked up at the sky with endless unwillingness in his eyes.

"I... don't... obey."

Enduring the severe pain in his body, the little beggar gritted his teeth and stood up again.

But the next moment.

Bang.

The little beggar fell directly to the ground.

At the same time, more and more blood flowed out.

At this moment, the little beggar seemed to have reached the limit of his life.

He opened his mouth and wanted to say something, but he could no longer make any sound.

"Do you want to live?"

At this moment, a tall figure appeared in front of the little beggar.

The next moment, the little beggar magically regained some strength again.

"I want to live, I don't want to die."

Lu Daosheng looked at the little beggar who was afraid in front of him. He saw a lot in the little beggar.

Not only did he see the unwillingness in the little beggar's eyes, but he also saw the little beggar's strong will.

How strong is this will?

Lu Daosheng could feel it clearly at home.

And this is also the purpose of his coming here.

"I can save you, what can you give me?"

Lu Daosheng asked slowly.

Hearing this question, the little beggar was silent.

He really has nothing.

Seeing the little beggar's silence, Lu Daosheng seemed a little disappointed, then shook his head slightly, turned around and left.

And at this moment, the little beggar's faint voice sounded behind him.

"I, I can give you someone who will never let you down."

"I will definitely do the best you ordered. Please save me."

At the end of the day, the little beggar's voice gradually choked up.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng stopped and turned around.

"Remember what you said today."

The next moment, a stream of light flashed by.

The injuries on the little beggar's body healed instantly, and a stream of force continued to improve his body.

"Do you have a name?"

The little beggar was silent for a moment and said slowly, "My name is Kong."

This name has not been mentioned for a long time.

He would forget what he called for after a long time.

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng nodded and said, "I have now initially improved your physique and can practice."

Hearing this, Kong was immediately excited.

He knew that the person in front of him was definitely the legendary cultivation power.

Unexpectedly, I can finally practice.

He used to dream of practicing so that he would never be bullied again.

But reality gave him a blow.

With his physique, he could not practice at all.

Coupled with long-term nutritional deficiencies, he looked like an eight-year-old child at the age of twelve.

There was no two taels of meat on his body.

"Thank you, benefactor."

Kong knelt on the ground and kowtowed to Lu Daosheng.

However, Lu Daosheng pulled Kong up.

The next moment, the world in the palm appeared on Lu Daosheng's palm.

"There are countless opportunities in it. How much you can get depends on your own luck."

"Remember what you said, it won't disappoint me."

Upon hearing this, Kong's expression suddenly became firm.

"Don't worry, my benefactor, I will definitely not let you down."

Immediately, Kong was directly sucked into the world in Lu Daosheng's palm.

One year outside, one thousand years inside.

From this moment on, the life of this little beggar named Huo has undergone earth-shaking changes.

It is hard to imagine that after endless years, the number one master under the Lord of the Huangcheng City was just a little beggar who was almost beaten to death.
